Context: 4. Seniority of Surplus Staff and Re-deployment

- 4.1. Surplus Employees.as fresh entrants.
- 4.2. Inter se Seniority of Surplus Employees.When multiple surplus employees of a particular grade in an office are selected on different dates for absorption in another office, their inter se seniority in the new office will be the same as in their previous office, provided no direct recruit or promotee has been selected for that grade in between the dates of their selection.
